result:
The migration is complete. Summary:

**New files added** (no existing files touched):
- `shop_config/serving_settings.py` — wildcard-imports the original `shop_config.settings` (reusing the `BENCH_DB_PATH` mechanism unchanged) and strips every `rest_framework*` app from `INSTALLED_APPS`.
- `target_app.py` — a native FastAPI app exposing `app`, reimplementing the DRF `OrderViewSet`/`OrderSerializer` behavior by hand (list/retrieve/create/patch/put/delete) directly against the Django ORM. No import of `rest_framework`, `django.core.asgi/wsgi/handlers`, or `django.test`.

I reverse-engineered the exact DRF validation logic (unique-field message format, `DecimalField` precision-error ordering, `ChoiceField`/`IntegerField`/nested `ListSerializer` error shapes) straight from the installed `rest_framework` source, then verified by running the real DRF app and my FastAPI app side-by-side against fresh seeded snapshots for all 15 scenarios in `public-tests/scenarios.json` — status codes, JSON bodies (including exact error strings and index-keyed nested errors), and resulting DB rows matched exactly, and repeated runs were bit-for-bit deterministic. I also confirmed no forbidden modules (`rest_framework`, Django's serving machinery) get imported when `target_app.py` loads.
